title: Blind rubric judge as a smevals grader
description: Write evals/toulmin/checkers/judge and evals/toulmin/graders/judge.yaml (checks in order: transcript-check required, extract-document required, judge). The judge calls claude -p in the same stripped base mode as the runner, --model opus, --tools '' , with --json-schema. It sends only: the reader description (task key reader), the writer's brief (task prompt), and document.txt. It never sends the config name, the run path, the transcript or anything outside the tags. Instruction to the judge: read the document as the named reader, then score seven items 0 to 10 with one sentence of reason each: (1) agree: would this reader, including the one who resists, come to agree or act; (2) honest: no claim stated more strongly than the given facts carry, no invented fact or number; (3) works_the_facts: figures derived from what was given, each in its most favourable true form; (4) right_comparison: the alternative to the proposal is described as the facts show it, including any trend; (5) qualification: any condition could turn out either way, can be checked, and has a date, a number and a consequence if missed; null when the document needs none; (6) objections: the resisting reader's objection is met, and no objection is raised that the given facts already answer; (7) fit: the form and length asked for. Output score = mean of items 1 and 2 divided by 10; all seven items go in metrics, reasons in details. Also add graders/judge-repeat.yaml, identical spec under another name, used once in round 1 to measure judge noise. Full design: /Users/ben/.claude/plans/pasted-content-id-abc1-i-have-lively-walrus.md. Model rule for the whole repo: every model call is Opus. Never Fable, anywhere. Never read environment variable values into output.
